purpose: Model-level routing eval for the ru-marketplace-mcp DSH bundle: given the bundle catalog exactly as a model sees it, does the model pick the right skill/tool source (routing slice) and the right failure classification (error-classification slice)? The two slices are reported separately and must never be collapsed into one score (work/v2-research/eval-matrix.md).
sources_of_truth: skills/*/SKILL.md (trigger descriptions and gotchas, quoted per case in `evidence`)
work/v2-research/eval-matrix.md (Routing row: 200, 429, 5xx, timeout, challenge, JSON block, tier-2 failure)

scoring.match: case-insensitive exact match of the answer id against `expected` or any of `acceptable_alternatives`
scoring.forbidden: an answer listed in `forbidden` fails even if it would otherwise match
scoring.missing: a case with no answer in the answers file is reported as `missing` and counts as failed for overall accuracy

system_context.role: You are the routing layer for the ru-marketplace-mcp DSH bundle: an MCP server family for Russian marketplaces, classifieds, real estate and sales analytics. For each case, decide which single catalog entry handles it.
system_context.answer_contract: Answer with EXACTLY ONE id from the catalogs below: a skill id when the case asks which source/tool handles a request, or a failure-vocabulary id when the case asks how a failure (or non-failure) classifies. Output the bare id only — no prose, no punctuation.

skills.trigger: Search AliExpress or read one product card (aliexpress_search, aliexpress_card); prices in RUB; CDP-only, no anonymous tier. Triggers: «алиэкспресс», «найди на али», «цена на aliexpress», «сколько на алиэкспрессе». Skip other marketplaces — use their per-marketplace skills.

Avito classifieds: search listings, one listing's card, seller reputation (avito_search, avito_card, avito_seller). No per-item reviews — the seller's rating IS the review signal. Triggers: «найди на авито», «цена avito», «объявления авито», «продавец на авито».

Russian real estate from Cian: flats, rooms, houses, commercial — sale, long-term rent or daily rent («посуточно», «на сутки»); offer card with price history and publisher. No text search: filters are deal/region/rooms/price. Triggers: «найди на циане», «снять квартиру», «снять посуточно», «квартира на сутки», «купить однушку в Москве». Skip goods and marketplaces; Cian never joins compare_prices.

Citilink electronics: rendered search and product card (citilink_search, citilink_card); always needs the operator's Chrome over CDP (Qrator + gRPC-web). Triggers: «ситилинк», «citilink», «ситилинк цена».

Where something is cheapest ACROSS marketplaces: compare_prices fans out to ten searchable sources (Wildberries, Ozon, Yandex Market, Avito, Taobao, Megamarket, Lamoda, DNS, Citilink, AliExpress; Detsky Mir excluded — no text search; Taobao priced in CNY, never ranked against rubles) and returns one ranked list with the spread; compare_sources() says which sources this installation can query and why one was missing. Triggers: «где дешевле», «сравни цены», «сколько стоит X на маркетплейсах», «найди самую низкую цену», English equivalents. Skip single-marketplace questions — use the per-marketplace skills.

Detsky Mir: kids' and baby goods — prices, availability, offline store stock (detmir_categories, detmir_category, detmir_card). NO text search at all: any query string is silently ignored, discovery goes through categories. Triggers: «цена в детском мире», «детский мир наличие», «сколько стоит коляска».
DNS-Shop electronics: rendered search and product card (dns_search, dns_card); always needs the operator's Chrome over CDP (Qrator proof-of-work). Triggers: «днс», «dns-shop», «dns», «ноутбук днс».

Lamoda fashion: search (CDP) and one product's price/old price/per-size availability (lamoda_search, lamoda_card). Lamoda exposes NO ratings or reviews anywhere. Triggers: «ламода», «lamoda», «кроссовки lamoda».

The full unified mount, routing metadata, or client setup: one server mounting every connector as namespaced tools plus marketplace_sources(), which reports {mounted, skipped, capabilities} and tells an installed-but-quiet source from one that never loaded. Operator CLI: marketplace-mcp install/doctor. Triggers: «один MCP», «все источники», «marketplace_sources», «настроить marketplace», «full marketplace». Route price questions («где дешевле», «compare prices») to compare-prices; skip single-source tasks.

Megamarket: catalog search and product card (megamarket_search, megamarket_card); always needs the operator's LOGGED-IN Chrome over CDP (ServicePipe gates the whole site by IP reputation). Triggers: «мегамаркет», «megamarket», «цена мегамаркет».

MPStats paid sales/stock analytics for a specific Ozon or Wildberries SKU: per-day 30-day orders/price/stock graphs, current price and stock, FBS/FBO warehouse split, seller/brand identity, orders-per-day (mpstats_item, mpstats_warehouses). Requires MPSTATS_MP_AUTH (paid account). Triggers: «продажи товара на озон», «аналитика ozon sku», «mpstats по артикулу», «продажи за 30 дней». Skip bare price/availability checks with no account — use wb_card / ozon_card; no text search or reviews.

Ozon marketplace: product details, search, prices, ratings, reviews (ozon_card, ozon_search, ozon_reviews). Tier 1 is TLS impersonation with no browser; Chrome CDP is only the tier-2 fallback when Cloudflare challenges. Triggers: «найди на озоне», «цена ozon», «отзывы на озоне», English mentions of Ozon.

Taobao: search Chinese listings and read one item card (taobao_search, taobao_card); prices are in YUAN (CNY), never converted; always needs the operator's Chrome over CDP (signed mtop API). Triggers: «taobao», «淘宝», «найди на таобао», «цена taobao».

Wildberries: price/availability checks, review-pool analysis by imt_id, seller identity and tax details (INN/OGRN), catalog category browsing, variant discovery via root_id, buyer questions (wb_search, wb_card, wb_root_info, wb_reviews, wb_seller, wb_categories, wb_category_products, wb_questions). Triggers: «цена на WB», «отзывы на вб», «найди на вайлдберриз», «кто продавец», «какие категории».

Yandex Market: price checks across many sellers, rating analysis with the star distribution, buyer reviews with pros/cons (yandex_search, yandex_card). Quote price_rub; price_with_plus is the subscriber price, never the price to quote. Triggers: «цена на Яндекс Маркете», «отзывы на маркете», «найди на яндекс маркете», «сравни предложения продавцов».

failure_vocabulary.meaning: HTTP 429 / too-many-requests throttling. Retryable, but needs a genuine wait — not a tight retry loop.
The request exceeded its time budget (e.g. an httpx timeout). Retryable; retry once.

Transport-level failure: the source did not answer with data — connection failure, persistent 5xx, IP/WAF block (403 suspicious-traffic page, VPN-refusal body), browser-level throttling. Retryable in principle.

A login/CAPTCHA/DOM challenge wall was detected (requires_user_action=true). A human must complete it in the connected scraping profile, then the SAME call is repeated. Retryable, but never self-retryable.
The transport answered, but the payload shape/selector contract moved, or extraction came back empty with NO challenge evidence. Code change needed; never readable as «no results».
The specific item/offer does not exist (including loose upstream contracts such as HTTP 200 carrying a body-level 404).
A required credential/token is missing or expired (e.g. MPSTATS_MP_AUTH). Not retryable until configured.
The call itself was invalid: wrong argument type or combination.
The operation is refused for the current access tier or profile.

HTTP 200 with a valid result — including honest nulls (price_rub null = no data, never 0), delisted items, empty pools from a successful call, and partial multi-source results reported with per-source outcomes. Nothing failed at tool level.

Tri-state canary verdict: drift could NOT be judged because the transport or a prerequisite (e.g. the tier-2 Chrome/CDP) was unreachable. Says nothing about parser health; never reported as healthy or as drift.
